contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head right. Reverse description: [soldier advancing left spearing] fallen horseman, who falls backwards off/below horse. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 1.77gms, die axis: possibly 12
